acceptance: A candidate engine/config change can be scored against the corpus without exposing gateway, App or classifier secrets to candidate code.
Results are authenticated end to end; no unauthenticated result file can satisfy the rule.
The rule is activated only with an authenticated baseline and a reviewed change; until then it reports inactive, never pass.
context: Origin: BenchBox-session handoff for #4062 (findings D5-D7) and owner decision 2 recorded on theseus-v025-review-convergence-20261107.
description: Theseus #54 makes the weekly eval score rule authenticate only scheduled main artifacts, so it cannot score a PR that changes engine or config: candidates must never receive gateway or classifier secrets, and candidate_env.py and isolation.py provide no credential broker or kernel sandbox. Owner decision 2026-11-09: keep the score rule explicitly inactive until an authenticated baseline exists, and design the trusted evaluator here.
